However, my [product_name] is the [version_no] type, which connects to computers via Ethernet and does not use an SD card. What steps can I take to resolve this problem? Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you!
Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. Which [product_name] are you using? Please provide the exact [article_no]. Is your SD card formatted with FAT32? What is the size of your SD card?

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters a download error indicating the absence of an SD card file system, even though their device does not require an SD card. This reflects confusion and highlights the need for clearer error messages and instructions tailored to hardware configurations without SD cards.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to download or update without needing an SD card and seeks guidance that aligns precisely with their device’s capabilities and setup.
